description: Ground truth for JARVIS command understanding (V1.0 decision milestone). Typed intent + important flags per utterance. Labels are written by hand; no model defined them. 'deterministic' = the Level-0 grammar is expected to decide it exactly; otherwise the Level-0 grammar must return nothing or the labelled intent, and the case measures a remote classifier or the router.
